data.body:
Implementation notes (build):
- Trigger seam: registry.project_applies_to_globs + criterion_matches_changed_files resolve a PROJECT criterion's effective applies_to globs; gate_dispatch._activated_code_review_project_criteria now takes the review's changed files and drops a gated criterion that matches none. Empty applies_to keeps the historical always-on behaviour, so project.review-phase-boundaries is untouched.
- Config override: [code_review] ci_config_globs (list[str], default []) REPLACES the routing globs of any criterion whose entry declares applies_to_config_key. The pointer is declarative, so no shipped module names a project criterion id or a CI vendor.
- Added file-impact path src/rebar/llm/criteria/overlay.py beyond the reviewed set: the new applies_to_config_key pointer is shape-validated at overlay load (extracted into _validate_applies_to_config_key) so a typo fails loudly instead of silently no-opping into the routing default. That is the same silent-degradation class this criterion exists to catch.
- Complexity ratchet tripped once when the validation was inline in _validate_routing_entry; fixed by behavior-preserving extraction, not by touching .github/complexity-baseline.json.
- Discovered follow-up: erratic-illhumored-norwayrat — the CodeReviewConfig re-export puts src/rebar/config.py at exactly the 800-line module-size cap (gate fails on > cap), leaving zero headroom for the next config addition.
